name: Precision Gooseneck Kettle
description: Temperature-controlled gooseneck kettle for pour-over coffee.
why_we_recommend: The #1 upgrade for anyone doing pour-over at home - controls pour speed and temperature, which are the two biggest variables in a good cup.

name: Conical Burr Grinder
description: Adjustable conical burr grinder for consistent grind size.
why_we_recommend: Grind consistency matters more than the brewer itself. This is the single highest-impact purchase for coffee quality under $100.

name: Ceramic Pour-Over Dripper
description: Classic 1-4 cup ceramic dripper, compatible with standard filters.
why_we_recommend: Retains heat better than plastic, and it's the dripper most online recipes are calibrated for - easiest starting point for beginners.

name: Digital Coffee Scale with Timer
description: 0.1g precision scale with built-in brew timer.
why_we_recommend: Ratio and timing are how you make a recipe repeatable. This is the cheapest way to go from 'guessing' to 'dialed in'.

name: Single-Origin Coffee Subscription
description: Monthly subscription delivering freshly roasted single-origin beans.
why_we_recommend: Recurring subscription products often pay recurring commissions, not just a one-time cut - worth prioritizing these in a niche store.

name: Online Home Barista Course
description: Self-paced video course teaching espresso and pour-over technique.
why_we_recommend: Digital products/courses often pay 30-50%+ commission with no shipping/returns risk for the merchant - much higher margin per referral than physical goods.
